items.markdown:
`Eligible ordinary passport holders can enter Thailand without a visa for up to 60 days for tourism and short-term business` , though this framework is transitioning to a tiered system with shorter limits for many nationalities. Always verify active regulations before departure via the Official Thai E-Visa System.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L8MW5xSp9LM)[[4]](https://atlasvolunteers.com/thailand-visa-exemption/)[[5]](https://thailandmagazine.com/thailand-travel-checklist/thailand-visa-rules/)

Key Requirements and Rules

- **Proof of Onward Travel:** You must hold a confirmed return or onward ticket showing departure from Thailand within your permitted stay duration.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa) 
- **Digital Arrival Card:** All foreign visitors must complete a digital arrival entry registration online before passing through immigration.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CQbZSCl-UJo)
- **Extension of Stay:** Visitors who enter under an eligible exemption can typically apply for a single extension of up to 30 additional days at a local Thai immigration office for a fee of 1,900 Thai baht.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) 
- **Overstay Penalties:** Staying past your authorized admit date incurs a fine of 500 Thai baht per day (up to a 20,000 baht maximum), alongside risks of detention or travel bans.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) 

If you share your **nationality** and **planned travel dates** , I can provide the most accurate length-of-stay allowance for your specific passport.
